description: VYBE Music v4.1.7 — Animated Dynamic Island with Live Equalizer Waveform, Instagram & Social Video Music Identifier, and Real-Time Cross-Device Admin Push Notifications.
changelog: Animated Dynamic Island: Live bouncing 4-bar equalizer waveform visualizer responding to active music playback
Spring-Physics Dynamic Island: Fluid morphing between compact pill, expanded controls, and song identification radar
Instagram & Video Music Identification: Share reels, TikToks, or Shorts into VYBE Music to identify songs and play with 1 tap
Real-Time Cross-Device Push Notifications: Announcements sent by admin to 'All Members' are broadcast instantly across all devices
Automatic Announcement Catch-Up: Offline or asleep devices catch up and display push alerts upon wake or startup
Liquid Glass Navigation Bar: Frosted translucent bottom pill with smooth spring tab glide
Listen Together Beat Sync Precision: Sub-20ms drift synchronization across all paired devices for zero-echo playback
Listen Together Bass Boost: Hardware-accelerated low-frequency bass boost synchronized across connected phones
Zero Lag Performance Optimization: Pre-cached viewmodels and buttery smooth 60fps scrolling
